report:
(A) Uterus with cervix and bilateral adnexa, total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy; omentectomy
(B) Omentum, omentectomy
(C) Lymph nodes, left pelvic, dissection

(A) The specimen consists of an intact uterus with cervix and bilateral adnexa from a total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. The bilateral ovaries and fallopian tubes are replaced by a mass measuring 40 mm in greatest dimension (40 x 30 x 25 mm). The outer surface bears papillary excrescences. Cut surface shows solid areas and necrosis. The fallopian tube is unremarkable. The uterus with cervix measures 80 x 50 x 35 mm; the endometrium is thin and the myometrium is unremarkable; the serosa bears tumour nodules up to 15 mm. The omentum (250 x 150 x 20 mm) contains a firm cake up to 45 mm.

(A1-4) Right ovarian tumour.
(A5-8) Left ovarian tumour.
(A9-10) Right fallopian tube, entirely embedded.
(A11-12) Left fallopian tube, entirely embedded.
(A13) Cervix.
(A14-15) Endometrium and myometrium.
(A16) Uterine serosa with tumour.
(A17-20) Omentum, tumour.

(A) Uterus with cervix and bilateral adnexa, total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy; omentectomy
Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy; omentectomy
- Hysterectomy type: Abdominal
- Specimen integrity (right ovary): Capsule intact
- Specimen integrity (left ovary): Capsule intact
- Specimen integrity (right fallopian tube): Serosa intact
- Specimen integrity (left fallopian tube): Serosa intact
- Tumour site: Bilateral tubo-ovarian
- Ovarian surface involvement: Present, bilateral
- Fallopian tube surface involvement: Not identified
- Tumour size: 40 mm in greatest dimension (40 x 30 x 25 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: High-grade serous carcinoma
- Histologic grade: Not applicable (high grade by definition)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a high-grade serous carcinoma. The tumour grows in solid sheets
  punctuated by slit-like spaces, with hierarchical papillary branching and
  cribriform and glandular areas. The cells are cuboidal to columnar with
  eosinophilic cytoplasm and markedly pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei
  including bizarre and multinucleated forms, with large eosinophilic nucleoli.
  Mitotic figures are numerous and include atypical forms, geographic and
  comedo-type necrosis is present, and tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes and
  psammoma bodies are seen. The fallopian tubes are examined entirely (SEE-FIM)
  and the mucosa is not involved. Immunohistochemistry: p53 shows an abnormal
  pattern (strong diffuse nuclear overexpression); WT1 positive, PAX8 positive.
- Lymphovascular invasion: Present
- p53 immunohistochemistry: Abnormal, Overexpression (strong, diffuse nuclear
  expression, more than 90%)
- Largest extrapelvic peritoneal focus: Macroscopic, more than 2 cm (45 mm),
  omentum
- Peritoneal / ascitic fluid: Not submitted / unknown
- Chemotherapy response score: CRS2 (moderate response), scored on the omentum
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Uterine serosa; Omentum

Margins
- Ectocervical / vaginal cuff margin: Uninvolved by carcinoma
- Parametrial / paracervical margin: Not applicable

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 5 examined; 1 involved
  - Number examined: 5 (left pelvic 5)
  - With metastasis more than 10 mm: 1
  - With metastasis 10 mm or less: 0
  - With isolated tumour cells only (0.2 mm or less): 0
  - Largest metastatic deposit: 12 mm, left external iliac
  - Largest involved lymph node: 14 mm, left external iliac
  - Extranodal extension: Not identified

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not identified

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: ypT3c ypN1b
  - Stage group (if cM0): IIIC

Additional findings
- Adenomyosis
- Ancillary studies: BRCA1/2 tumour testing requested; result to follow
- Additional notes: Interval debulking after three cycles of carboplatin and
  paclitaxel

(A) UTERUS WITH CERVIX AND BILATERAL ADNEXA, total hysterectomy and bilateral
salpingo-oophorectomy
- HIGH-GRADE SEROUS CARCINOMA, tubo-ovarian, bilateral, 40 mm, ovarian surface
  involved; see synoptic report
- involving the uterine serosa and omentum; largest extrapelvic peritoneal focus
  45 mm; lymphovascular invasion present
- 1 of 5 regional lymph nodes involved; chemotherapy response score CRS2
- ypT3c ypN1b (AJCC 8th edition), stage IIIC (if cM0)

(B) OMENTUM, omentectomy - METASTATIC HIGH-GRADE SEROUS CARCINOMA, largest deposit 45 mm

(C) LYMPH NODES, left pelvic, dissection - METASTATIC CARCINOMA IN 1 OF 5 LYMPH NODES, largest deposit 12 mm
